C1523.title: Terra Ecosystem Projects Hit by Bulk Google Keyword Ad Phishing Attack
C1523.summary: Between April 12 and 21, 2022, approximately 52 addresses on the Terra blockchain had funds maliciously transferred, resulting in a total loss of around $4.31 million. Analysis confirmed the attack was a bulk Google keyword ad phishing campaign.
